description:
Send a direct message, privately, in the account's name. Name exactly one of conversation_id or comment_id.

conversation_id answers a thread from messages_list, and only while its replyUntil has not passed — Meta allows a reply within 24 hours of their last message and refuses after it.

comment_id opens a thread from a comment in comments_list: somebody who comments on your post can be messaged once, within 7 days. One message, not a conversation — they have to answer before you may send another. Use it when a comment needs an answer that does not belong in public.

You can never message someone first. If they have neither written nor commented, there is no way to reach them and no permission that grants one.

This is private and comments_reply is public. Answering in the wrong one either exposes something meant for one person or hides an answer everyone was waiting for.

comment_id.description: A comment from comments_list. Sends its author one private message.

conversation_id.description: A thread from messages_list. Answers it.

name: messages_reply
title: Send a direct message
